Did you see what just happened?!
We just witnessed an electrifying moment as **[Vivek Ramaswamy](https://substack.cc/redirect/6e96114e-74c0-4944-a485-52abcbb71c03?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** threw down the gauntlet! He challenged every presidential candidate, regardless of party affiliation, to step up and commit to pardoning President Donald Trump.
I had the honor of delivering the opening remarks at Vivek's press conference _(full remarks below)_ , where I highlighted the broader significance of this issue. As some of you may remember from my 2022 Senate campaign, Donald Trump endorsed Dr. Oz instead of me in the Republican primary only for Dr. Oz to lose in the general election. Backing Dr. Oz obviously did me no favors or in the end, the people of Pennsylvania.
**This transcends the presidency itself. This is about YOU!**
However, it is crucial to recognize that this is not about me or Dr. Oz or even Trump. This transcends the presidency itself. _**This is about YOU, the people!**_ If they can subject a former president to such treatment, what's to prevent them from doing the same to you?
This isn't a time for playing it safe or staying on the sidelines. The destructive forces of division and anger have plagued us as a nation for far too long. Vivek's call is an invitation to mend our wounds, bridge our differences, and construct a more robust and prosperous America.
Never forget that forgiveness and mercy are signs of strength, not weakness. Let's be clear: this is about what's best for our nation, but it's not about evading accountability. Our legal system will address any alleged wrongdoings, but we must not allow ourselves to be trapped in an endless cycle of retribution. Now is the time to leave behind the shackles of division and embrace the path of peace and progress.
**... forgiveness and mercy are signs of strength, not weakness.**
Together, let's seize this extraordinary opportunity at this pivotal moment in our nation's history and refuse to shrink. They're no longer hiding their bias and criminality. They're doing it in right in your face!
So what are you going to do about it? I'm talking to you, Tim Scott, Nikki Haley, Ron DeSantis and the rest of the GOP.
If you want to lead us, then prove it! Follow Vivek's lead and stand up for your country, not just your political ambitions.
With few exceptions, most of you did nothing when they locked down our country. You did nothing when they locked up innocent citizens who attended a rally on Jan 6. You missed those shining opportunities to lead. So here you go. Here's your chance to lead, served up on a silver platter.
Will you take it?
**Kathy Barnette
National Grassroots Director, Vivek 2024**

name: Nancy Rotering, Mayor of Highland Park, IL
subject: Gabe Amo will stand up to the gun lobby & protect our communities from gun violence
body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP50/1/105455/images/Gabe%20Amo%20Header_V6.png]

Hi Friend,

I’m Nancy Rotering, the mayor of Highland Park, Illinois.

Gabe Amo was the first call I received from the White House after a mass shooting shattered my community last summer. As President Biden’s Deputy Director for Intergovernmental Affairs, he was a constant source of communication from Washington, D.C. and helped to kick start the process of healing in Highland Park.

When the cameras left, and we were left with the devastation and trauma of that awful day, Gabe was the person who continued to give us hope.

And that’s why I’m proud to support Gabe Amo for Rhode Island’s 1st Congressional District.

Some will wonder why the mayor of a town in Illinois is asking voters in Rhode Island’s First Congressional District to support Gabe’s campaign for Congress. The answer is clear: gun violence is a crisis that affects all of us.

We need common sense gun safety legislation at the federal level and Gabe is ready to stand up to the gun lobby and protect Rhode Island’s communities. Rhode Islanders deserve — and are demanding — an elected leader in Congress who can be an effective advocate for the safety of communities across Rhode Island and around the country. That person is Gabe Amo.

Click the video [https://youtu.be/l11z9Caahfk] below to hear why I support Gabe’s campaign:

https://youtu.be/l11z9Caahfk [https://youtu.be/l11z9Caahfk]

Please show your support by donating to Gabe’s team [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mnr] today.

CHIP IN [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mnr]

With gratitude,

Nancy Rotering
Mayor
Highland Park, IL

name: Jenny Beth Martin, Tea Party Patriots Action
subject: This Flag Day is different.
body:
| | |
---
Today, June 14th, is Flag Day. It is also President Trump’s birthday. Happy Flag Day to my fellow Americans and happy birthday, President Trump! I have to say, however, that this Flag Day is different. While there is joy in celebrating our flag and President Trump’s birthday, there is also the realization that we face a most corrupt government that has been weaponized against conservatives. The gravity of the moment in which we live must be acknowledged. The breathtaking, Soviet-style persecution of President Trump is atrocious and cannot be ignored. The left’s replacement of our nation’s flag – the flag that represents all Americans and unites us – with the so-called “progress flag” is shameful and wrong and also cannot be ignored. The left is not joking around. They intend to jail their opponents if they can get away with it. They intend to force you to salute and honor their chosen flag, while trampling on the real American flag. Patriot, **Did you get my team 's recent email?** They wanted to remind you of what delivering results looks like. I came in as governor in 2018, winning by 32,000 votes out of more than 8 million votes cast. Prior to running, I was advised to bide my time, keep my head down, and not rock the boat because our state was a toss-up on voter registration and performance. I understand why they said that, _**but with all due respect, I rejected that advice. **_**We went in on day one. We were very bold. We were very ambitious. **Fast forward four years later-- November of 2022--we didn't win by 32,000 votes, we won by over 1.5 million votes. This was the most votes a Republican governor candidate had ever gotten. We were winning places that Republicans haven't won in a very long time, including winning independent voters by 18 percentage points and winning more than 60% of Hispanic voters. That is what you call bringing people to your platform and attracting voters. But while the results are important, HOW we did it is just as critical to understand. We didn't do it by pretending to be more moderate or shifting our agenda to the Left. No, we did it by sticking to our principles. By being authentic and being honest with voters. Even when they disagreed, we told them the truth. That is how we attract more and more people to our cause. We CAN do this. I'm ready. Are you?

| A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.
---
Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn't stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism."

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:
* Record tax relief

* ESG prohibitions

* Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

* The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

* Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency

* Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

* Improvements to our state's infrastructure

* Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists

I’ll get into more detail below, but first: **[Will you chip in $5 to activate your official membership and help us protect our Democratic majority?](https://go.dscc.org/go/14072?amount=5&t=5&firstname=&lastname=&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&addr1=&addr2=&city=Cresco&state=Pennsylvania&zip=18326&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&ask=5&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C50&code=DPE-FD-20230614-GaryPeters-PetersMembership23-ETG-sl1&refcode=DPE-FD-20230614-GaryPeters-PetersMembership23-ETG-sl1&akid=11035%2E9716520%2EtBf8qi)**

Last cycle, the DSCC made _historic_ investments in field organizing and direct voter contact. In fact, we spent more on our grassroots efforts than on TV ads. That type of campaigning turned close races into blue victories -- and it was all thanks to the resources that thousands of grassroots Democrats helped to build by donating, taking action, and activating their memberships.

I won’t lie to you: The 2024 Senate elections are going to be even tougher than last year’s. We’re defending twice as many seats as the GOP, so our margin for error is _zero._ But I’m optimistic because I know what this team can do.

**Together, we can -- and must -- hit every goal and overcome every obstacle. And that's why I'm reaching out.**

I just got word from our finance team that we’re short on our June membership goal in Pennsylvania. They assured me that you’re one of our top supporters in the fight to hold the Senate, so with no room to fall short, I’m asking you to help out before tomorrow's mid-month deadline:

**[Will you chip in $5 to activate your membership and join the grassroots movement that's defending our razor-thin Senate majority? >>](https://go.dscc.org/go/14072?amount=5&t=6&firstname=&lastname=&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&addr1=&addr2=&city=Cresco&state=Pennsylvania&zip=18326&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&ask=5&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C50&code=DPE-FD-20230614-GaryPeters-PetersMembership23-ETG-sl1&refcode=DPE-FD-20230614-GaryPeters-PetersMembership23-ETG-sl1&akid=11035%2E9716520%2EtBf8qi)**

Thanks for being on our team,

Sen. Gary Peters
DSCC Chair

# The Battle to Flip Texas Blue.

I wanted to share some big news with you today: I am officially running for Congress in Texas’s 8th District.

As a mom, a business owner, and a born-and-raised Texan, I know that real representation starts with having a voice from one of us, not a career politician.

My campaign and winning a seat in the United States Congress will be instrumental in achieving better representation for our communities and flipping Texas BLUE.

[**In a moment, I’m going to explain why running is so important to me, but if you’re ready to flip Texas blue and win for the 8th district, chip in today!** ](https://laura4tx.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=65529f44b849c16925ad85a66&id=027cb6d027&e=a2a46ff12c)
[](https://laura4tx.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=65529f44b849c16925ad85a66&id=40e2e0af63&e=a2a46ff12c)
**Some things you may not know about me:**

I served as the Chair for the San Jacinto County Democrats and Field Director for Texas Senate District 3 under the Texas Democratic Party's Non-Urban Rural Caucus.

I was born and raised in Houston, Texas, where my Husband and I raised our 6 children and operated a successful business.

I fell in love with the peace and tranquility of rural Texas. So a few years ago, my husband and I built a home with our two youngest children here.

However, I immediately noticed the lack of proper representation. As Field Director, I traveled around East Texas talking to residents, and I heard many times that they felt as if their voices were not heard. Many issues have gone unresolved for decades, and we now face real challenges with our healthcare, public education, the climate crisis, and job security in many rural Texas communities.

As a tax-paying resident and mother of children attending a rural community's local schools, I could not just sit back and allow things to decline. And so I am running to be a part of the change that we desperately need in our community.

I am ready to be one of us for all of us.

[**If you’re ready to be a part of our campaign and see that we have the momentum needed to flip Texas, please chip in today. It would mean the world to me.**](https://laura4tx.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=65529f44b849c16925ad85a66&id=ff63933c8e&e=a2a46ff12c)

America is about to lead the world again -- into peace

| [ ](http://www.kennedy24.com/?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=peace_speech&n=1)
---
Dear Peter, On June 20th, Robert F. Kennedy, Jr. will make history. Marking the anniversary of President John. F Kennedy's speech at American University, Mr. Kennedy will announce a fundamentally new direction for American foreign policy. With his election in 2024, our country’s decades long journey into military imperialism will be over. subject: Important climate votes today and tomorrow!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Oregon League of Conservation Voters
body:
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/64816090/411352549/1274810701?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjFkZWQ1NTBmLWNhMGEtZWUxMS05MDdjLTAwMjI0ODMyZWI3MyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=mbcRgGqI2mCU1RDpGl3Le7SDQbsEIySdVhJzQpXEt7c=&emci=8c9921d7-c40a-ee11-907c-00224832eb73&emdi=1ded550f-ca0a-ee11-907c-00224832eb73&ceid=2107230) | | | Dear Peter, Some of our Priorities for a Healthy Oregon are joining forces with more than a dozen game-changing bills to form the most comprehensive climate action package in Oregon history: the new, bipartisan Climate Resilience Package (HB 3409 and HB 3630). The House is scheduled to vote on this package today and tomorrow. [**Can we count on you to take action now and urge your lawmakers to vote YES on the Climate Resilience Package?**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/64816091/411352550/1274810701?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjFkZWQ1NTBmLWNhMGEtZWUxMS05MDdjLTAwMjI0ODMyZWI3MyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=mbcRgGqI2mCU1RDpGl3Le7SDQbsEIySdVhJzQpXEt7c=&emci=8c9921d7-c40a-ee11-907c-00224832eb73&emdi=1ded550f-ca0a-ee11-907c-00224832eb73&ceid=2107230) The Climate Resilience Package (HB 3409 and HB 3630) is a combination of almost 20 bills to reduce climate and air pollution; support healthy, affordable, resilient communities; and create family-wage jobs across Oregon. **Two of our priorities** , the Resilient Efficient Buildings package (SB 868-871) and the Natural Climate Solutions bill (SB 530), **are part of this new package that will invest $100 million to bring home 10 times that—up to $1 billion in federal funding to Oregonians.** This new package offers real hope — that’s why it already has the support of lawmakers on both sides of the aisle. We all know that the climate crisis demands bold and broad action, and we’re so grateful for everything you have done to hold strong and advance meaningful climate action so far this session. [**But we need your continued support as we push to make sure this package is a top priority for our lawmakers in their final days of work.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/64816092/411352551/1274810701?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjFkZWQ1NTBmLWNhMGEtZWUxMS05MDdjLTAwMjI0ODMyZWI3MyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=mbcRgGqI2mCU1RDpGl3Le7SDQbsEIySdVhJzQpXEt7c=&emci=8c9921d7-c40a-ee11-907c-00224832eb73&emdi=1ded550f-ca0a-ee11-907c-00224832eb73&ceid=2107230) We can’t afford to miss out on this once-in-a-generation opportunity to address the climate crisis. Lawmakers must act urgently to tackle Oregon’s second largest source of climate pollution — our homes and buildings — and take advantage of historic federal funding. If they don’t, Oregon won’t just leave billions of federal dollars on the table, we will leave Oregonians — especially frontline communities — vulnerable to the worsening effect of the climate crisis. And we can’t let that happen. [**Please write to your lawmakers today asking them to vote YES on the Climate Resilience package.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/64816093/411352552/1274810701?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjFkZWQ1NTBmLWNhMGEtZWUxMS05MDdjLTAwMjI0ODMyZWI3MyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=mbcRgGqI2mCU1RDpGl3Le7SDQbsEIySdVhJzQpXEt7c=&emci=8c9921d7-c40a-ee11-907c-00224832eb73&emdi=1ded550f-ca0a-ee11-907c-00224832eb73&ceid=2107230) In partnership,
Julia DeGraw
Coalition Director, OLCV | |

body:
United Rural Democrats [https://can2-prod.s3.amazonaws.com/uploads/data/000/670/558/original/logo.png]
Hi Peter,

Tomorrow, we're hosting an exclusive event for URD supporters to meet with Rep. Chris Deluzio, who represents Western Pennsylvania in Congress.

| | Dear friends,

Please forward this upcoming event to friends and family who may live in Broadmoor:

June 22nd @ 7:00 PM I'll be hosting a very important Town Hall Meeting at the Broadmoor Community Center to discuss the future of the Broadmoor Police Department. We will have Chief Connolly from the BPD and a representative from LAFCo speaking on this crucial neighborhood safety issue.

If you can attend, please RSVP with Mike Richardson on my staff: 650-363-4572 or [mrichardson@smcgov.org](mailto:mrichardson@smcgov.org?subject=Broadmoor%20Town%20Hall%20Meeting%20\(6%2F22%20%40%207%3A00%20PM\))

In Friendship,

David Canepa
San Mateo County Supervisor, District 5

With ballots out, now is the perfect time to get out there and volunteer on a conservative campaign. Every door you knock on in these local races matter a lot and the results of this election year will be used as a bellwether for the 2022 midterms.

We are also hosting another WSRP Statewide Day Of Action on Saturday, October 30th! Bring a friend or neighbor to volunteer for a few hours to help local conservatives win in November! Sign up here to join our Statewide Day Of Action! (https://form.jotform.com/212737084845058)
State Sen. Gildon On Vaccine Mandates
https://soundcloud.com/user-450836972/wagop-report-state-sen-chris-gildon-on-vaccine-mandates-and-democrat-anti-policing-laws
State Senator Chris Gildon (R - Puyallup) joins the podcast this week to discuss vaccine mandates, anti-policing laws, the Long-Term Care Tax, and how he got his start in politics. WAGOP is now on Apple Podcasts and Spotify, follow us and never miss an episode! Listen here. (https://soundcloud.com/user-450836972/wagop-report-state-sen-chris-gildon-on-vaccine-mandates-and-democrat-anti-policing-laws)
Republican Leaders Fight Inslee's Mandate
Thanks to our Republican leaders in the State House and Senate for fighting back and offering a strong rebuke of Inslee's harmful vaccine mandate. Below is an excerpt of their most recent statement to the press:

“We are already experiencing higher prices and empty shelves partially as a result of COVID's shutdowns and workforce shortages. Today's deadline, with its unnecessarily hardline consequences, will only make that worse when hundreds, if not thousands, lose their jobs and are denied unemployment benefits. It also threatens public safety by reducing our police forces at a time when crime is already rising. People feel unsafe. They are afraid of what criminals will do when there are even fewer law enforcement officers to respond. And they are worried about people's chances of survival if there aren't enough first responders to help in an emergency. The governor underestimates the potential impact of his actions.

“Coercion, intimidation, threats and public shaming are not tactics a leader should be using against the people. The governor's obvious disdain for those who are choosing to lose their jobs rather than compromise their right to make their own medical decisions is unhelpful. He is dividing the public – segregating us and turning people against each other. Yesterday, even unvaccinated health-care workers were heroes. Today, they become villains in the governor's narrative."

Read the full statement. (https://jtwilcox.houserepublicans.wa.gov/2021/10/18/republican-leaders-todays-vaccine-deadline-threatens-critical-services-public-safety/?fbclid=IwAR3WxI9H29hbbmfbZhdkDS9QjqdVd2TIRCdjNjUkUlLdeThtbUjK_WBWJuw)
Smiley Campaign Shows Grassroots Support In Latest Fundraising Quarter
Tiffany Smiley is fighting hard to retire Patty Murray and her latest fundraising numbers show not only has Tiffany raised more than $1.6 million but she also has unequivocal grassroots support, with over 10,000 donors from Washington State. Flipping a U.S. Senate seat is hard work but Tiffany has shown in the only 5 months since starting her campaign, that she is a force to be reckoned with. Learn more about how Tiffany stands on the issues here (https://www.smileyforwashington.com/issues) .

An ordinary person would feel pretty demoralized right after getting arraigned as an innocent man and hearing that the Department of Justice wants to send you to prison for **400 YEARS.**
But that’s why I can confidently say that my father is _extraordinary._

That’s the man I know as my father, and the man my 5 kids get to look up to as their grandfather.

Today is my father’s birthday, and I know that nothing would make him happier than if we told him how much we raised to peacefully defend our movement from the Left’s latest assault.

subject: We're suing California
body:
If you care about protecting free speech and your right to push back against radical ideology online, then the Bee needs your support in this fight.

| | | [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zoc1m566eb0rjpu9vcjos044kej39ip8kg4h0teg_rp22sh2s8i66o73ctjmapb4chh2bs)

Fellow Free Speech Lover,
---
| | This is Seth Dillon, CEO of the Babylon Bee. Whether you’ve seen me on Tucker Carlson’s show, or if you’ve come across our biting satire online, you probably know that, despite jokes being our bread and butter, The Babylon Bee takes free speech and fighting censorship seriously.
---
| [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zeqlqetq9qiej5dg3msktsoj8ff5vre8jbrqavhg_rp22sh2s8i66o73ctjmapb4chh2bs)
---
| | **That is why we’ve filed a lawsuit against California’s Attorney General to stop the enforcement of its new censorship law.** If you care about protecting free speech and your right to push back against radical ideology online, then the Bee needs your support in this fight. [**I hope you’ll consider standing with us today by becoming a Babylon Bee subscriber.**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2ze8tfenfi42a7di0etsnbr3hg54kc7hkhunaiabg_rp22sh2s8i66o73ctjmapb4chh2bs)
---
[Stand with the Bee](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zfdtmhjks4tvj01ete73lmocjmfk6jbgq88vgbmo_rp22sh2s8i66o73ctjmapb4chh2bs)
---
The state of California passed a law in 2022 that imposes new regulations on social media companies. This law, AB 587, requires companies to give the California Attorney General’s Office regular reports regarding disinformation, misinformation, extremism, radicalization, and hate speech. The law allows the state to impose fines if companies do not comply with these reporting regulations. You may be asking, “Isn’t controlling misinformation and hate speech online a good thing?” The truth of the matter is that the government and Big Tech companies working together to control what everyone is allowed to say is a bad thing. A good thing is when everyone is allowed to speak freely. Not everyone’s definitions of “misinformation” or “hate speech” are the same. In the case of our work at The Babylon Bee, jokes and satire are often incorrectly cited as examples of misinformation or hateful conduct by organizations and government agencies who think our views don’t fit their prescribed narrative. When people in power don’t like what you have to say, they can use that power to categorize your speech as “hateful,” even if what you’re saying is factually accurate.
---
[Stand with the Bee](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z26vn93m495tcutul719lor26nqsv1ot8i6o0c28_rp22sh2s8i66o73ctjmapb4chh2bs)
---
**_This law is not about keeping social media companies transparent — it’s about censorship._** The state of California, along with other government entities and Big Tech firms, is seeking to use censorship to protect their preferred narrative. We believe this is a violation of the First Amendment and we — along with our co-plaintiffs Tim Pool and Minds — are taking California to court to fight it. [**In times like these, your support is crucial**.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zl9ntg0q4v1tt56rflo1aarava2dk0vt1lr6nblo_rp22sh2s8i66o73ctjmapb4chh2bs) If you have not taken the step to become a paid supporter of The Babylon Bee, now is the time. Each paid member helps us keep fighting these attempts to control what we can and can’t say. Free speech — even when it comes to satire and jokes — is a vital pillar of our nation. Standing up for this fundamental right is something we will never back away from -- and thousands of free speech-loving Americans have shown us that they’re ready to do the same. [**Are you one of them? If so, I hope you’ll click here to view our subscription plans and sign up to offer your support.**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zj2drkt2f1bn4nb3fcebjlp4erdm0qi271a7pmo8_rp22sh2s8i66o73ctjmapb4chh2bs) With your help, we will continue fighting these battles in and out of the courtroom, in any way we can.
---
[Stand with the Bee](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z6hnf0hqap2lu0uan4n6i6250ci0mkcdbmmp962g_rp22sh2s8i66o73ctjmapb4chh2bs)
---
Thank you in advance for joining us in the battle for free speech.
---
Seth Dillon
CEO | The Babylon Bee

name: James H. Harvey III, American Veterans Center
subject: I was a Tuskegee Airman
body:
In 1949, I was on a small pilot team at the Air Force’s first Fighter Gunnery Meet.

| | | [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z201lfhaa1i6j9fb5fa5eid62bks1d47g6ujmas8_rp22sh2s8i66o73ctjm6ob1c3h2bs)
---
Fellow American, I was one of the first “Top Guns” of the U.S. Air Force. In 1949, I was on a small pilot team at the Air Force’s first Fighter Gunnery Meet. Over multiple days, we competed against other squadrons in dive bombing, skip bombing, rocket firing, panel strafing, and aerial gunnery at 20,000 and 12,000 feet – _and we won_. But the Air Force listed the 1949 competition winner as “Unknown” for 46 years because our team was composed of Tuskegee Airmen ... and they didn’t want people to know we were so good.
---
[](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zvj885euqf4tpi0o5fj0kkh1fn60avdbppjqo6fg_rp22sh2s8i66o73ctjm6ob1c3h2bs)
---
_Above: My friends at the American Veterans Center recorded a special video documentary about my military service in World War II and the Korean War._
---
**I** ’**m a proud 22-year military veteran who served in World War II and the Korean War with the 33rd Fighter Group, better known as the Tuskegee Airmen.** In addition to being one of the Air Force’s first “Top Guns,” I was the first African-American combat pilot to fly in Korea, and I went on to fly more than 125 missions there. I’m proud to share my story of patriotism, service, and hard work with the next generation and to see the Tuskegee Airmen I served with recognized for their skill and bravery – after so many years of stonewalling and silence. **I truly understand the importance of recording and sharing veterans** ’ **stories so we can honor the men and women who served and inspire young Americans.** That’s why, when my friends at the American Veterans Center told me they needed to raise more funds to record veterans’ stories – from World War II to today’s Special Forces – I knew that I had to take action. [**Can I count on you to chip in $25, $50, $75, $100, $250, $500, or more right now to help support the American Veterans Center** ’**s critical work to honor veterans** ’ **legacies? As a non-profit organization, AVC depends on support from patriotic Americans like you.**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zen2egfm072fpk299vkulughfpsnndj4oeuvnvv8_rp22sh2s8i66o73ctjm6ob1c3h2bs)
---
[Support the American Veterans Center](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zl5eo62eak7v7k5cln6qmjufvjkbholad4g9kcno_rp22sh2s8i66o73ctjm6ob1c3h2bs)
---
[](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zgnpjb53i555bi6nmoqf253tsuhidplg80s9ug28_rp22sh2s8i66o73ctjm6ob1c3h2bs)
---
_Above: I was honored to join AVC_ ’ _s Annual Conference – alongside my fellow Tuskegee Airmen and in the company of hundreds more veterans, students, and military cadets – in Washington, D.C. this year._
---
I was proud to partner with the American Veterans Center for a 37-minute video documentary about my service in World War II and Korea – and also about the Tuskegee Airmen’s long journey to rightful recognition for our skill and service. **No other group does as much as the American Veterans Center to safeguard our veterans** ’ **legacies and to let our veterans tell their own stories in their own words.** [**That** ’**s why I** ’**m writing to you today to ask for your support of the American Veterans Center** ’**s critical work. Will you make your most generous tax-deductible gift of $25, $50, $75, $100, $250, $500, or more today?**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zg1e5q7jqn6aalkd8dni5g6kjh7apvi4v6rqeu48_rp22sh2s8i66o73ctjm6ob1c3h2bs)
---
[Support the American Veterans Center](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z1qp6gu615n8mhp1j1me61f5as53l071mvv11it8_rp22sh2s8i66o73ctjm6ob1c3h2bs)
---
As a young man, I stood outside in my yard and looked up as a formation of P-40 Warhawks flew overhead. In that moment, I knew I wanted to become a pilot. **Today, I hope that my story of serving America – in World War II, in the Korean War, and as one of the first** “**Top Guns” in the Air Force – will similarly inspire the next generation of young people.** Every year, the American Veterans Center reaches _millions_ of Americans through their video documentaries ... their National Memorial Day Parade ... and their Annual Conference for veterans, students, and military cadets. [**Will you join me in supporting the American Veterans Center – and helping them reach even more veterans and young people with their powerful programs – and make a gift of $25, $50, $75, $100, $250, $500, or more right now?**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zggn76fqg90pkfvedsspok1im880s2l1q90cnbsg_rp22sh2s8i66o73ctjm6ob1c3h2bs)
---
[Support the American Veterans Center](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zvtmqa8p4i6b7jilvdvnbcgsk39llajlotupu5k8_rp22sh2s8i66o73ctjm6ob1c3h2bs)
---
Friend, your support will help the American Veterans Center pass on the lessons of veterans like me – lessons of service, sacrifice, patriotism, duty, and courage. Thank you for helping the American Veterans Center preserve the stories of American heroes so together we can inspire the next generation.

---
Lt. Col. James H. Harvey III U.S. Air Force (Ret.) For the American Veterans Center

I came in as governor in 2018, winning by 32,000 votes out of more than 8 million votes cast. Prior to running, I was advised to bide my time, keep my head down, and not rock the boat because our state was a toss-up on voter registration and performance. I understand why they said that, _**but with all due respect, I rejected that advice. **_ **We went in on day one. We were very bold. We were very ambitious. ** Fast forward four years later-- November of 2022--we didn't win by 32,000 votes, we won by over 1.5 million votes. Peter, this was the most votes a Republican governor candidate had ever gotten. We were winning places that Republicans haven't won in a very long time, including winning independent voters by 18 percentage points and winning more than 60% of Hispanic voters. That is what you call bringing people to your platform and attracting voters. But, Peter, while the results are important, HOW we did it is just as critical to understand. We didn't do it by pretending to be more moderate or shifting our agenda to the Left. No, we did it by sticking to our principles. By being authentic and being honest with voters. Even when they disagreed, we told them the truth. That is how we attract more and more people to our cause. We CAN do this, Peter. I'm ready. Are you?

| A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.
---
Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn't stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism."

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:
* Record tax relief

* ESG prohibitions

* Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

* The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

* Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency

* Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

* Improvements to our state's infrastructure

* Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists

* The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border crisis

* Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions

* Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country, leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

Ron is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award- winning television anchor. Together, they're the proud parents of their daughters, Madison and Mamie, and their son, Mason.

June is a critical month as we face a public Federal Election Commission (FEC) filing deadline on the 30th. June is a critical month as we face a public Federal Election Commission (FEC) filing deadline on the 30th. **And the heat has kicked up a notch because this is the FIRST public filing we will face since two opponents have announced their intentions to run.**

I’m not worried — I’m confident in this team and our ability to take on big fights.

But with less than a year until the PA primary, GOP operatives, the media, and my opponents will be watching our fundraising report closely to decide whether or not our campaign is vulnerable.

**I’m proud to run a people-centered campaign, especially heading into what’s sure to be a contentious, expensive 2024 cycle — one where I expect _heavy_ spending against me in the hopes of flipping PA-04.**

[**Let me be clear, Peter: I will not allow DeJoy to harm the USPS with longer delivery windows, price hikes and shutdowns.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/64821743/411374031/729550529?source=20230614_em_pet_b1_raja_30_v2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDUvMS83MzE2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzZjRmMzNmZC1kNjBhLWVlMTEtOTA3Yy0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=dvuqc91ybLHZP1VGVNoAkkuabeP4Bsb9HQmuuEMhZ4A=&emci=eaf69560-d00a-ee11-907c-00224832eb73&emdi=3f4f33fd-d60a-ee11-907c-00224832eb73&ceid=21346897)

name: Paul "Bud" Haedike, American Veterans Center
subject: I was at D-Day
body:
My plane was shot down by the Germans in my first combat mission in World War II.

| | | [](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zia9ep9bbfiagk7862i532h97o7auo01rb58st0g_rp22sh2s8i66o73ctjmepj7c3h2bs)
---
Fellow American, My plane was shot down by the Germans in my first combat mission in World War II. Our rookie B-17 crew was in "Tail End Charlie," which is what we called the last plane in the formation to pass over the target. The Germans had zeroed in on us with 88 millimeter cannons -- which could fire five miles up -- and they hit our number one and number two engine. A B-17 is not made to stay up on two engines. But with skill, determination, and good fortune, we crash-landed in Belgium just over the Nazi lines. Five days later, we were rescued ... and I went on to fly 22 more missions.
---
[](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2z75gqu8jv77b703kt4l92d6j5d7n9o0bhla7kng0_rp22sh2s8i66o73ctjmepj7c3h2bs)
---
_Above: The American Veterans Center recorded and released a 30-minute video documentary with me about my service in World War II._
---
**A few years ago, my friends at the American Veterans Center invited me to record a video documentary about my experience in World War II.** I was proud to share my story with the American Veterans Center (AVC), both to honor the memories of the brave men I served with and to pass on our hard-fought lessons to the next generation. Right now, the American Veterans Center is working around the clock to interview and record as many video documentaries as possible with World War II veterans like me. [**May I ask you to chip in $25, $50, $75, $100, $250, $500, or more today to help fund the American Veterans Center** ’**s critical video documentary project? As a non-profit, AVC depends on the contributions of patriotic Americans like you.**](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zv15rhm08bbaqer1usr77qqksubmhuaq1gsaj1g0_rp22sh2s8i66o73ctjmepj7c3h2bs)
---
[Help the American Veterans Center](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zsi725jokd8m5t86mpf5ukajr3i4pha8428me1k8_rp22sh2s8i66o73ctjmepj7c3h2bs)
---
When the American Veterans Center records video documentaries with veterans like me:
• The experienced AVC video team coordinates travel plans with the veteran and his or her family. Oftentimes, AVC will even send out their staff to veterans’ homes – of course, at no cost to the veteran.

• AVC records a beautiful, professional-quality video documentary that lets veterans tell their own stories in their own words. A keepsake copy is also given to the veteran and their family to enjoy. • AVC makes available – for free! – these powerful video documentaries to be used as part of our shared American history. These videos reach millions on YouTube and have been used by the Library of Congress, presidential museums, and award-winning films. [**Can I count on you to help the American Veterans Center record even more video documentaries with your gift of $25, $50, $75, $100, $250, $500, or more today? Your gift is urgently needed for AVC to continue their efforts.**](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zln7f8e2vm7v2lqfrjes4h0lc6kfse0dkirab118_rp22sh2s8i66o73ctjmepj7c3h2bs)
---
[Help the American Veterans Center](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2z2ed369tca24v5jhidm48i05pp6pvj59h7k9arpg_rp22sh2s8i66o73ctjmepj7c3h2bs)
---
The history books will teach you the facts, but only the servicemen and women of World War II can tell you what it was really like. In the beginning of the war, they said if a guy flew six or eight missions, he was on borrowed time. There were many men who served with me who didn't come home. They didn't get to be husbands, didn't get to be dads, and none of them got to be grandfathers -- which you can't understand until you reach that point in your own life. _Thanks to the American Veterans Center, and generous Americans like you who made my video documentary possible, my story, and the story of the young men in the Eighth Air Force, has entered our shared American history._ [**To help preserve the legacy of more World War II veterans like me, please make your most generous gift to the American Veterans Center today.**](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2z22b69gjhr0tq5d2vothlogtr1tqagna6t342118_rp22sh2s8i66o73ctjmepj7c3h2bs) I understand first-hand what good, important work the American Veterans Center does – and why their mission to record video documentaries with more veterans like me is so urgent. [**That** ’**s why I** ’**m asking for your support of the American Veterans Center today.**](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2z6pn0dnvr7ldqdbq7ik0sj9j2nffaog4j2mh3ln8_rp22sh2s8i66o73ctjmepj7c3h2bs) Thank you,

subject: We're suing California
body:
If you care about protecting free speech and your right to push back against radical ideology online, then the Bee needs your support in this fight.

| | | [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zr72fst2vlss17cmsuk1e5nc16n0gt5stb89svh0_rp22sh2s8i66o73ctjmepj0c3h2bs)

Fellow Free Speech Lover,
---
| | This is Seth Dillon, CEO of the Babylon Bee. Whether you’ve seen me on Tucker Carlson’s show, or if you’ve come across our biting satire online, you probably know that, despite jokes being our bread and butter, The Babylon Bee takes free speech and fighting censorship seriously.
---
| [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z11lh5j1jf43a4jpnh5b4vgq1pulei43q1e0pv5g_rp22sh2s8i66o73ctjmepj0c3h2bs)
---
| | **That is why we’ve filed a lawsuit against California’s Attorney General to stop the enforcement of its new censorship law.** If you care about protecting free speech and your right to push back against radical ideology online, then the Bee needs your support in this fight. [**I hope you’ll consider standing with us today by becoming a Babylon Bee subscriber.**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zb9sh38d5nrlglsl96u9meugsje1q6kob1pkmm7g_rp22sh2s8i66o73ctjmepj0c3h2bs)
---
[Stand with the Bee](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z9m708nbvml4n9l16nfbvm9vdrjlvivmhd38itug_rp22sh2s8i66o73ctjmepj0c3h2bs)
---
The state of California passed a law in 2022 that imposes new regulations on social media companies. This law, AB 587, requires companies to give the California Attorney General’s Office regular reports regarding disinformation, misinformation, extremism, radicalization, and hate speech. The law allows the state to impose fines if companies do not comply with these reporting regulations. You may be asking, “Isn’t controlling misinformation and hate speech online a good thing?” The truth of the matter is that the government and Big Tech companies working together to control what everyone is allowed to say is a bad thing. A good thing is when everyone is allowed to speak freely. Not everyone’s definitions of “misinformation” or “hate speech” are the same. In the case of our work at The Babylon Bee, jokes and satire are often incorrectly cited as examples of misinformation or hateful conduct by organizations and government agencies who think our views don’t fit their prescribed narrative. When people in power don’t like what you have to say, they can use that power to categorize your speech as “hateful,” even if what you’re saying is factually accurate.
---
[Stand with the Bee](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z9875jaackgvq51kaut0kd3619khf4hqiaiafen8_rp22sh2s8i66o73ctjmepj0c3h2bs)
---
**_This law is not about keeping social media companies transparent — it’s about censorship._** The state of California, along with other government entities and Big Tech firms, is seeking to use censorship to protect their preferred narrative. We believe this is a violation of the First Amendment and we — along with our co-plaintiffs Tim Pool and Minds — are taking California to court to fight it. [**In times like these, your support is crucial**.](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zvms30v6c0mveq1kmtb56amqsg1hcdelhjlcv34g_rp22sh2s8i66o73ctjmepj0c3h2bs) If you have not taken the step to become a paid supporter of The Babylon Bee, now is the time. Each paid member helps us keep fighting these attempts to control what we can and can’t say. Free speech — even when it comes to satire and jokes — is a vital pillar of our nation. Standing up for this fundamental right is something we will never back away from -- and thousands of free speech-loving Americans have shown us that they’re ready to do the same. [**Are you one of them? If so, I hope you’ll click here to view our subscription plans and sign up to offer your support.**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zu0nukg59316jic9v3vk2nak57kcsquj5eu4q37g_rp22sh2s8i66o73ctjmepj0c3h2bs) With your help, we will continue fighting these battles in and out of the courtroom, in any way we can.
---
[Stand with the Bee](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z7adrk7d748gc8fuec67vsb2br3p8797htbuqnc0_rp22sh2s8i66o73ctjmepj0c3h2bs)
---
Thank you in advance for joining us in the battle for free speech.
---
Seth Dillon
CEO | The Babylon Bee

name: Senator Chris Murphy
subject: I am asking you to do something small, but important.
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Alex Padilla for Senate
body:
#

_Hi there — I wanted to share this message from Sen. Chris Murphy with you. I hope you’ll take the time to read what he has to say, and then make a contribution to support his campaign if you can afford to do so. Thanks. - Alex_
* * *

Friends,
I’m writing to share a story with you. It’s a personal one that ties together my work on gun safety, my family, and the importance of perseverance and action.
When I’m done, I’m going to ask you to split a donation between my campaign and Alex Padilla before the official FEC fundraising deadline on June 30.
If you understand the importance of this deadline and want to skip the story, you can contribute here. It’d mean a lot:
[**https://act.alex-padilla.com/go/Chris-Murphy**](https://act.alex-padilla.com/go/553?c0=ap-em-june23-murphy.hAcl5h&refcode=em230614-1-30&t=1&akid=1344%2E159979%2EIGFRFx)
Otherwise, the story starts about halfway through my 15-hour filibuster about gun violence in America three days after the mass shooting at Pulse Nightclub in Orlando, Florida.
I remember looking up at the gallery and seeing my wife, Cathy, sitting with my oldest son Owen, who was then 8 years old. I had been standing and speaking on the floor for about 8 straight hours, and I had no good way to keep in touch with the outside world, so I was surprised when I saw Cathy and Owen looking down on me. It was emotional, since my gun violence work is so personal, I can’t stand to live in a world where my kids — or any kids — go to school worrying whether they will make it home alive.
When I saw them, I had to take a minute to compose myself. But when I got myself together, I looked right at Owen and told him that though I was sorry I had to miss Wednesday pizza night with him and his brother and Mom, I knew that someday he would understand why I was doing what I was doing.
I told him that nothing would ever change in the world for the better unless people make the effort to create change.
In a way, my filibuster worked. I forced the Senate to take a vote on my universal background checks bill. But we lost the vote.
And we lost a number of votes after that.
But we kept fighting. We kept building our movement. And last summer, almost exactly six years since I looked up and saw Cathy and Owen in the gallery, we passed the most significant gun safety legislation in three decades.
As a senator, I can do big and impactful things like the filibuster that day (and night).
But even if you’re not a senator, all of us have important roles to play in the fights to create meaningful change.
Today, I am asking you to do something small, but important. I’m asking you to donate to keep me in the Senate where I can continue fighting for you.
Some can give a little. Some can give a lot. But the important thing is the number of donations we receive before this deadline. So I am asking:
[**Can I count on you to split $5, or whatever amount you can afford today, between my re-election and Alex Padilla? Do it before our FEC fundraising deadline ends on June 30.**](https://act.alex-padilla.com/go/553?c0=ap-em-june23-murphy.hAcl5h&refcode=em230614-1-30&t=2&akid=1344%2E159979%2EIGFRFx)

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. Peter,
Today, I wanted to take a moment to acknowledge a very special occasion – the birthday of the United States Army! Today, we commemorate the Army's founding and the brave men and women who have served and continue to serve our country.

As a proud member of Congress, it is my honor to express my deepest gratitude to all the soldiers, veterans, and their families for their sacrifices and dedication. The U.S. Army plays a crucial role in ensuring our nation's safety and protecting our freedoms. They work tirelessly to defend our country's values and keep us safe from harm.

The U.S. Army has a rich history that dates back to June 14, 1775, when the Continental Congress established it. Over the years, the Army has evolved and adapted to changing times and challenges. Today, it remains a symbol of strength, courage, and resilience. It is made up of individuals from diverse backgrounds, who come together to form a unified force, working as a team to overcome any obstacle.
Throughout history, the Army has been involved in numerous important missions, from defending our nation during times of war to providing assistance during natural disasters and humanitarian crises. The men and women in uniform demonstrate unwavering commitment and selflessness, always putting the needs of others before their own.

On this special day, let us take a moment to recognize the immense contributions of the U.S. Army to our nation. It is through their service and sacrifice that we are able to enjoy the freedoms we hold dear. We owe them a debt of gratitude that can never truly be repaid.

Thank you,

clean_body: | | | | \- - -| Peter, Today, I wanted to take a moment to acknowledge a very special occasion – the birthday of the United States Army! Today, we commemorate the Army's founding and the brave men and women who have served and continue to serve our country. As a proud member of Congress, it is my honor to express my deepest gratitude to all the soldiers, veterans, and their families for their sacrifices and dedication. The U.S. Army plays a crucial role in ensuring our nation's safety and protecting our freedoms. They work tirelessly to defend our country's values and keep us safe from harm. The U.S. Army has a rich history that dates back to June 14, 1775, when the Continental Congress established it. Over the years, the Army has evolved and adapted to changing times and challenges. Today, it remains a symbol of strength, courage, and resilience. It is made up of individuals from diverse backgrounds, who come together to form a unified force, working as a team to overcome any obstacle. Throughout history, the Army has been involved in numerous important missions, from defending our nation during times of war to providing assistance during natural disasters and humanitarian crises. The men and women in uniform demonstrate unwavering commitment and selflessness, always putting the needs of others before their own. On this special day, let us take a moment to recognize the immense contributions of the U.S. Army to our nation. It is through their service and sacrifice that we are able to enjoy the freedoms we hold dear. We owe them a debt of gratitude that can never truly be repaid. Now, as I begin my re-election campaign to win back my seat in the Tennessee House, I am more committed than ever to continuing our fight for change. I will not sit back and watch as gun violence consumes our country and devastates our communities. I will fight back against Republicans who protect the gun lobby at the expense of their constituents. We have the power to bring people together and work through these deep-rooted issues, be a voice for our communities, and fight this violence head-on. By electing state Democrats like me, we can meet this moment and pave the way for progress in states like Tennessee. The current one is [the judge chosen to preside over the case, Aileen Cannon, is a Trump stooge](https://default.salsalabs.org/T9a97a30f-6639-4cfd-afe7-ae6ec3766f0c/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) who tried so hard to stymie the original investigation [she was ripped & overruled by a 3-judge panel of GOP appointees from the 11th Circuit Court, including 2 Trump judges](https://default.salsalabs.org/Ta3915c62-c963-47bc-8bf5-6c5d7f3494ff/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)! As Slate put it: So, we must [convince her to recuse herself from this case, or remind the 11th Circuit why they rebuked her](https://default.salsalabs.org/T114dd19d-e82e-48a2-90e9-e1394bf37ff9/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9), and therefore must remove her, which they can do. At the [Blue Amp Channel](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tec3908d4-2982-48dd-aaba-eb65f9059e68/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) we [interviewed one of the leading experts on federal courts, Steve Vladeck](https://default.salsalabs.org/T94edb95e-254c-4ba0-aa05-d3581f76f3d9/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9), who has argued cases before the U.S. Supreme Court, is a law professor at the University of Texas at Austin and bestselling author.[Vladeck warned about Cannon](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tf345a7b8-299f-434b-8e7c-4a9ea158608d/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9). Below there are 2 videos, [a specific clip where he discusses Cannon along with my commentary](https://default.salsalabs.org/T18b98742-9766-41b0-8cd3-b51bae374775/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9), and [the longer podcast that goes into more detail](https://default.salsalabs.org/T17599222-5ba2-4241-9ac5-8ab09b1ec500/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9). I ask you to watch at least one, both if you can, and to share. with family, friends, neighbors, fellow church/temple/mosque attendees, your book club, PTA or anyone else you can think of. body:
---
| | | | | | | | | | [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/62823192:6Ei1RYINM:m:1:3299561967:476B14C59534A64B3E154C157EE0C735:r)

Patriot,

Let me be blunt: we're facing a system that is increasingly antagonistic to Western values.

Joe Biden is taking the country in the wrong direction.

You know it, I know it, and the American people know it. They are already voting with their feet! It's why our population is booming in the free state of Florida.

_But I believe conservatives should refuse to retreat to Florida._

**Far from it: It 's time to play offense and take back our country from the woke ideology that threatens our nation's freedom. **

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/62823192:6Ei1RYINM:m:1:3299561967:476B14C59534A64B3E154C157EE0C735:r)
---

We need leadership in the executive branch--someone who can set a course and mobilize our country to get there.

That's exactly what I did in Florida. We've fought for freedom against the bureaucratic COVID regime and dangerous woke ideology...

And not only did that fight get us victory after victory on the policy front, it yielded a 20-point re-election at the ballot box.

Now, we need the courage to lead and the strength to win our whole country.

I'm running for President to lead our great American comeback because I believe freedom is worth fighting for. **[Will you fight alongside me?](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/62823192:6Ei1RYINM:m:1:3299561967:476B14C59534A64B3E154C157EE0C735:r "Will you fight alongside me?")**

---
| | [YES, I'M READY TO WIN](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/62823192:6Ei1RYINM:m:1:3299561967:476B14C59534A64B3E154C157EE0C735:r)
---

And we can win.

We can have an economy that works for working families, a secure border that works for our nation, and so much more. I'm excited to share my agenda for America with you throughout this campaign.

**But here 's why I'm writing you today: [I want to ask you to become a Donor to my presidential campaign and join our first Team Teletownhall.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/62823192:6Ei1RYINM:m:1:3299561967:476B14C59534A64B3E154C157EE0C735:r "I want to ask you to become a Donor to my presidential campaign and join our first Team
Teletownhall.")**

I promise you, unlike other campaigns, our grassroots fundraising program is built on the principle that our donors are a part of our team, not our personal piggybank.

_I vow to treat you with respect: No smoke and mirrors, no fake matches, and no lies._

Can I count on you?
---
| | [DONATE NOW](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/62823192:6Ei1RYINM:m:1:3299561967:476B14C59534A64B3E154C157EE0C735:r)
---

In Freedom,
Ron DeSantis

---

**Meet Ron DeSantis**
---
| | | | [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/62823192:6Ei1RYINM:m:1:3299561967:476B14C59534A64B3E154C157EE0C735:r)
---
| A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.
---
Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn't stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism."

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:
* Record tax relief

* ESG prohibitions

* Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

* The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

* Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency

* Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

* Improvements to our state's infrastructure

* Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists

* The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border crisis

* Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions

* Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country, leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

Ron is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award- winning television anchor. Together, they're the proud parents of their daughters, Madison and Mamie, and their son, Mason.

Nearly 250 years later, that flag might look a little different, but the principles for which it stands are as important as they’ve ever been. It represents our commitment to liberty and justice, as well as the courage of our veterans who defended it at all costs.As we strive to form a more perfect union, there are some who say America is characterized only by its past mistakes. They will insist we are defined only by a deplorable history of racism, sexism, and a whole bunch of other isms. **But we know the truth: America is the greatest country in the history of the world.** [**Sign our petition to tell the Department of Education to stop promoting woke history and start teaching real history.**](https://larryelder.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6a42253df6197f177f9e13389&id=a24bd2b9bf&e=0be619cbaa) EDespite what the radical left says, we must teach our kids to be proud of their country and its history. As we salute our flag today and every day, may we always be thankful for the people and lessons that shape our shared American story. Sincerely, **Larry Elder

There are only nine federal judges who aren’t bound by an enforceable code of conduct. They all serve on the Supreme Court. And we’ve all seen the consequences. Justices ruling on cases with personal and financial conflicts of interests. Refusing to recuse themselves from cases that could impact their own family members. Speaking at events and attending all-expenses-paid trips funded by groups doing business before the Court. Look: the honor system just isn’t cutting it. **We need a binding, enforceable code of conduct to ensure that members of the nation’s highest court are held to the highest standard of ethics.** [**So last week, Representative Pramila Jayapal and I reintroduced our Judicial Ethics and Anti-Corruption Act to make it happen. * Make the Supreme Court follow a binding Code of Conduct
* Ban federal judges from owning individual stocks
* Tighten restrictions on gifts and privately funded travel (yes, Justice Clarence Thomas, we’re looking at you)
* Overhaul the broken recusal process (once again looking at you, Justice Thomas)
* Create new tools to hold judges accountable for ethical misconduct

And here’s one reason why rooting corruption out of the judiciary is so powerfully important: the public’s trust in our judicial system is plummeting. When someone has their day in court, they shouldn’t have to wonder whether the judge in front of them is making decisions based on their financial interests rather than the rule of law. **In other words: our diverse identities and experiences combined make us who we are.**

That means that when one of our fundamental freedoms is under attack, _all_ of our fundamental freedoms are under attack. You’ve seen the headlines: Last week, an intense level of smoke blanketed the northeast.

As a doctor, I know how dangerous poor air quality can be. It poses long-lasting damaging health effects for _everyone_. With climate change continuing at speeds faster than any scientist expected, we’re only going to experience deteriorating air quality.

Our children deserve to be able to live, learn, and play without harmful environmental toxins surrounding them.

That’s why Their Future PAC’s climate action policy is clear:

✅ We stand for environmental justice. Climate action shouldn’t just be quick, it should be equitable.

✅ We believe in the need to remove environmental toxins like neurotoxic pesticides and mercury from areas kids spend time in and push for federal regulations controlling toxic substances.

✅ We believe that our children should have access to uncontaminated natural resources. We advocate for policies that reduce pollution in our waterways, in the atmosphere, and more.

✅ We support technological development as critical to climate change mitigation, from those that implement renewable energy sources, carbon sequestration technologies, and other yet-to-be-imagined technologies.

✅ We believe that our children deserve to inherit a stable environment. We acknowledge the unique role that carbon emissions play in climate change and support policies that reduce carbon emissions on a national and international level.

✅ We recognize the role of sustainable development in ensuring the health of our environment and communities, supporting policies that encourage sustainable development.

✅ We believe children have the right to live free from environmental threats. We support the Paris Climate Accord and advocate for policies that aim to limit global temperatures from rising above 2oC through market, technological, and legislative measures.

It is time to stop standing by and start helping in the fight for a better tomorrow. Our children deserve so much better than the planet we are passing down to them.
