A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.

Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the “Russia collusion” conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what’s right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom – even when it wasn’t popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America’s founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation’s revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
-
Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,
-
Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden’s border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,
-
Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,
-
Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,
-
Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,
-
Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,
-
Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,
-
Protecting the unborn,
-
Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,
-
Expanding education freedom,
-
Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,
-
Lowering prescription drug costs,
-
Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,
-
Creating a universal school choice program,
-
Delivering record-breaking tax relief,
-
Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,
-
Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,
-
Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,
-
Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,
-
...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn’t stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican – as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: “When the world lost its mind – when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue – Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism.”

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor’s leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden administration’s overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor’s vision, this year’s legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida’s history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:
-
Record tax relief
-
ESG prohibitions
-
Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP
-
The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.
-
Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency
-
Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI
-
Improvements to our state’s infrastructure
-
Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists
-
The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden’s border crisis
-
Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions
-
Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida
No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country, leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

Ron is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award- winning television anchor. Together, they’re the proud parents of their daughters, Madison and Mamie, and their son, Mason.

**The Wall Street Journal
Editorial Board
June 13, 2023**
“... If Mr. Trump is the GOP nominee, he is unlikely to defeat Joe Biden. But if he did win, the document fiasco is what a second term would be like. He wouldn’t be able to deliver the conservative policy victories that Republicans want because he can’t control himself. He’d be preoccupied with grievance and what he calls ‘retribution.’ The best people won’t work for him because they see how he mistreated so many loyalists in the first term.
“**If Republicans really want to defeat Democrats, the press and a hostile bureaucracy, they’ll nominate a candidate who won’t shrink from a fight** but will also be smart enough not to blunder into obvious traps.
“If Republicans nominate Mr. Trump again, they won’t ‘own the libs,’ as the faddish saying goes. The libs will own them.”

All of it despite Fox agreeing to pay Dominion Voting Services a punishing $787.5 million to settle a defamation lawsuit that had already exposed the lies and misinformation were known and approved by executives at the top, including Fox billionaire owner Rupert Murdoch. **The reality is Fox “News” isn’t actually a news channel at all. ** It’s a dangerous and divisive spreader of disinformation campaigns and **if you subscribe to cable TV -- even if you never watch the channel -- YOU are helping fund it!** That’s because all the major cable companies actually pay Fox something called “carriage fees.” It’s guaranteed revenue and helps create their 35 to 40% profit margin. In fact, most of their money comes from these fees making Fox one of the few TV channels that doesn’t care about commercials. Even if Fox lost all of their advertisers, they would still be profitable. **But that could all change, if we act fast.** These carriage fees are up for renegotiation right now and with the shocking revelations that came out of the Dominion case and the still ongoing Smartmatic defamation lawsuit, Fox is in a significantly weakened bargaining position. If the cable companies hear from customers in big enough numbers, they could decide to treat Fox like every other cable news channel and not pay any more carriage fees moving forward. They could decide to offer a Fox-free cable bundle for those of us unwilling to subsidize right-wing disinformation. **They could decide to stop the spread of lies altogether and completely deplatform Fox now. ** To be clear, this type of pressure has worked before. Last summer, grassroots pressure got Verizon and DirecTV to stop streaming the One America News Network -- completely deplatforming another right-wing propaganda outlet that helped spread the Big Lie about the 2020 election. Let’s make sure Fox is next. | Peter —

MAGA Republican Anna Paulina Luna of Florida **just announced on the House floor** that the vote to censure and fine me $16 million will happen within the next _**two days**_ with GOP Speaker Kevin McCarthy’s personal support. [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/64835289/411402243/1815789988?amount=10&amounts=10,25,50,100,250&refcode=UTS_20230614_EMSPL_E2_T0_AC&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNy8xLzg5NDc2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImU3MjVlODA3LWVlMGEtZWUxMS05MDdjLTAwMjI0ODMyZWI3MyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=GIuLbraJ77_9-zwHhboISLBg2vBkHgD_1nKDS2zI-GM=) While the national media and political pundits focus their attention on disgraced, twice-impeached ex-president Donald Trump’s arraignment in downtown Miami on 37 federal counts returned by the grand jury, **MAGA Republicans are out for revenge against me personally.**

Peter, this vote to censure me — and even fine me $16 MILLION — _could actually pass with a GOP majority._

The authors of the Big Lie are attacking me for telling the truth, and it’s blatant political retaliation for my efforts to hold Trump accountable for his abuses of power. For leading his first impeachment and Senate trial. For serving on the January 6th Committee to investigate the insurrection he incited on our Capitol. | | FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
June 14th, 2023
Contact: Info@lwfaa.com
**MENTAL DIALOGUE TO PRESENT “ASK A BLACK REPUBLICAN”
FEATURING KELVIN AND JANELLE KING**
Atlanta, GA - Mental Dialogue's "All I Ask Is That You Think" series is presenting "Ask A Black Republican," featuring Kelvin and Janelle King, founders of Let's Win For America Action. The event will take place at Urban Grind, located at 962 Marietta Street Northwest, Atlanta, GA, 30318, on June 16th.

_"This is a great opportunity for engaging discussions on racial stereotypes surrounding Black conservatives,"_ expressed Kelvin King _. “It's my belief that no party or candidate should assume they have a person’s vote based on the color of their skin. The trust of diverse communities AND their support at the ballot box should be earned through honest dialogue and sound policy. It’s important to have those authentic conversations year-round, not only when we have an impending election. That’s why Janelle and I are excited to participate in this event.”_

Mental Dialogue's website describes the event as a town hall-style meeting focusing on African Americans who vote Republican and exploring the reasons behind their choice. The discussions aim to address questions such as whether Black Republicans are considered race traitors or if the Black community should diversify their votes between the two major parties. When asked about the political leaning of Mental Dialogue’s average attendees they replied, "_Left-leaning."_

Admission to the event is open to all, with a suggested donation of any amount. For those unable to attend in person, the event will be live-streamed. Registration for the event is now available at [mdlivex2023.eventbrite.com](https://LWFAA.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2e05b015cc2e6982fdaa22b89&id=f9c5551a4c&e=cb396c52a2).

For media inquiries or further information, please contact Info@lwfaa.com.
###
_Mental Dialogue is a platform that seeks to foster meaningful conversations and create spaces for African Americans to engage in critical thinking and dialogue. The organization facilitates discussions, events, and online interactions to encourage the exchange of ideas, promote understanding, and empower the community.

Let's Win For America Action (LWFAA) is a grassroots organization dedicated to promoting conservative values within diverse communities. Through outreach, education, and engagement, LWFAA aims to empower individuals to make informed decisions and contribute to the political landscape._

body:
I have a special gift for you--a set of unique notecards featuring pictures of the "Liberty Walk" statues found on the Hillsdale College campus.

This sponsored message from Conservatives Give is on behalf of Hillsdale College [ ](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=e6334fea36f24a09992b559ad3c6a358&_e=k3Qqt_-7xIqVgCTr02nPnhBLO6Wug0XmhoAp3-uMD-PZFQB5UbPriRZtndSHUX5C2NbrUzrog4SyffB_NF7O26e7ElvyGuHgUOsIRL8IgpF1sx-UMwoArGVoS6tbJkme6nhtqK1hLj6QFDNvCvC2wYU_jyXKZOS1zUJPkWzFnbO4G-SFdHIWRHWoX0UN2dWILdhjygOxIdEUxO8blBwZjqa8HrB7hBaP5EwcGd5DIUaNtkM8V3roRmdtRtV9ApkEWfwVukzTkXk612qN8DAEVBKiyLfQsC1i2mAKia7thhLYZaEy66kB2i_Y0xeR2Ei2KcLJPGcdX96dUT3O3mK4eEOMlMUxE7WmSyyhjOifuEJrtpX91JrLh5-CjuEEhTQWjL6kbTEji0EYGPeqakeB7id5N99F_SeyzjKY50BoLv0%3D) Friend of Liberty, I have a special gift for you--a set of unique notecards featuring pictures of the "Liberty Walk" statues found on the Hillsdale College campus. These beautiful cards include _George Washington_ and _Thomas Jefferson_ ... _Abraham Lincoln_ and _Frederick Douglass_ ... _Winston Churchill_ , _Margaret Thatcher_ , and _Ronald Reagan_. _All of these statues stand proudly on Hillsdale 's Michigan campus_--one of the only institutions of higher learning that refuses EVERY PENNY of government funding, even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants and loans. You can view the cards at this secure link: [https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/get-your-liberty-walk-notecards](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=e6334fea36f24a09992b559ad3c6a358&_e=k3Qqt_-7xIqVgCTr02nPnhBLO6Wug0XmhoAp3-uMD-PZFQB5UbPriRZtndSHUX5C2NbrUzrog4SyffB_NF7O26e7ElvyGuHgUOsIRL8IgpF1sx-UMwoArGVoS6tbJkme6nhtqK1hLj6QFDNvCvC2wYU_jyXKZOS1zUJPkWzFnbO4G-SFdHIWRHWoX0UN2dWILdhjygOxIdEUxO8blBwZjqa8HrB7hBaP5EwcGd5DIUaNtkM8V3roRmdtRtV9ApkEWfwVukzTkXk612qN8DAEVEFDq10tpJOULFj_5s7sPebsgDBJvg2aPIvjIN_WQ90ge-Mzi6WxKCnfzXNqk1jxoThz-gSRxbqXFUjOvcg2x-NDogE0Fn7BYilsPgier94KJDO7buTpZzTwP5_baVHd8PJaNOMm61PFRFghj8USAR0%3D) Let the cards serve as a reminder to you of the vigilance and commitment needed to defend liberty--especially right now, a critical time for our country. **Sadly, several polls and events around the country show that increasing numbers of young Americans are being drawn to socialism and other ideas destructive of liberty. ** And the unrest in communities nationwide, where statues of our Founding Fathers are being vandalized or torn down, is another symptom of this underlying disease. What explains this development? As an educator and president of Hillsdale, I've been thinking about this for a long time. Here's one primary reason... For decades, the "progressive" leftist academics who became dominant in most of America's colleges and universities after the 1960s have been teaching a **biased** and **distorted** view of American history. _The New York Times '_ "1619 Project" is a prime example. According to the "1619 Project," the key to understanding America is not freedom, but slavery--and the Project's main goal is to inject this false teaching into the curricula of America's K-12 schools. Imagine young minds in classrooms all over American learning this. Does it make you as concerned as it does me? And given this trend in American education, is it any wonder that our young people feel less of a patriotic attachment to our nation and are increasingly attracted--out of ignorance--to failed ideas such as socialism, ideas that are destructive of liberty? Another sign of the "progressive" Left's influence is the continuing attempt to erase our American heritage by destroying monuments, renaming schools and streets, and censoring works of literature in the name of "political correctness." The Left knows that it cannot remake society according to its ever-evolving idea of "progress" until it has "canceled" patriotism and hallowed out the idea that we should be grateful for our blessings to the great men and women of the past--many of whom are depicted on the cards I'd like to send you. **This is why we are engaging the Left on the battlefield of education ... and why your generous support is needed right away. ** After all, those on the Left are extremely well-funded, thanks to liberal billionaires like George Soros and his ilk. **With the support of citizens like you --citizens who understand the importance of education to liberty--we are ramping up its outreach efforts on behalf of liberty, especially to our nation's youth.** It is even more urgent that we do so in the face of efforts such as _ The New York Times_' "1619 Project" that undermine patriotism and lead to an increased pull toward socialism. Hillsdale is the only educational institution in America that is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens of all ages, from coast to coast, about America's great heritage of liberty. **Your generous support today will... **
* **Expand** the circulation of _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale's digest of liberty, to reach millions more Americans (you can also receive a free subscription of _Imprimis_ ...for life).

* **Send** millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to schools across America, and to members of our armed forces, who have sworn to defend the Constitution.

* **Increase** the number of citizens (especially younger Americans) enrolling in Hillsdale's free online courses such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope."

* **Launch** and support more and more Hillsdale-affiliated classical K-12 charter schools nationwide, returning excellence to American K-12 education and impacting thousands of our youngest citizens.

One other thing you should be aware of... As I mentioned, to maintain our independence, we do all of this liberty-defending work while refusing EVERY PENNY of government funding--even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants and loans. NOT. ONE. PENNY. So, your support is even more crucial to ensuring that future generations of Americans will be educated in American civics and prepared to defend freedom. **With a gift of $17.76 or more today to support educational outreach efforts that reach and teach millions, Hillsdale will send you a special notecard set featuring the statues on our "Liberty Walk." The cards are a thank you for your support. ** Supplies are limited, so please make your best tax-deductible gift right away. **You can view the cards and give your best tax-deductible gift of $17.76, $25, $50, $100, or even $250 or more by following the secure link below:** [https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/get-your-liberty-walk-notecards](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=e6334fea36f24a09992b559ad3c6a358&_e=k3Qqt_-7xIqVgCTr02nPnhBLO6Wug0XmhoAp3-uMD-PZFQB5UbPriRZtndSHUX5C2NbrUzrog4SyffB_NF7O26e7ElvyGuHgUOsIRL8IgpF1sx-UMwoArGVoS6tbJkme6nhtqK1hLj6QFDNvCvC2wYU_jyXKZOS1zUJPkWzFnbO4G-SFdHIWRHWoX0UN2dWILdhjygOxIdEUxO8blBwZjqa8HrB7hBaP5EwcGd5DIUaNtkM8V3roRmdtRtV9ApkEWfwVukzTkXk612qN8DAEVGGnUNQmBe83L_eTMs5E53piMyxwRyDmGLjq-pTAFLvJk1Jy5bIDyfo7vmutJWp75lvMs7t9yh88wpqYwB4REmA7yBpe1qE7ikMqUeExdDnIl5cAvjCR6eQQihCzS_h4_e3iTgRo3F-RKtNB7ryI2iU%3D) After receiving your notecards, I hope you'll send one to a young person you know, encouraging them to learn more about the Constitution and American history. You can even recommend that they take advantage of Hillsdale's many free educational resources. The Left is going all out, as illustrated by _The New York Times '_ "1619 Project." It is urgent that we engage forcefully on the battlefield of education ... which is why your support is needed today. **Because as always, our only sure defense is an educated citizenry prepared to defend liberty --no matter the cost. ** Warm regards, Bill Gray Vice President National Donor Outreach Hillsdale College

| | | Friend, It’s been nearly a year since the U.S. Supreme Court overturned _Roe v. Wade_ , and reproductive rights are under attack all across the country. Many Republican states are enacting laws that ban abortion in the first few weeks of pregnancy. **It’s heartbreaking.** Here in Alaska, abortion is still legal, and a woman’s health care choices remain her own. Alaska can be a model for other states to follow, if we can spread the word far and wide. [**Will you make a contribution to help us show that Alaska is leading the way on reproductive rights?**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/64837913/411410170/1859846009?refcode=E3015-20230614-PurpleStateModel-SL-AbortionReproRights&amount=25&utm_campaign=em_230614_reprorightsalaska&utm_source=em&utm_medium=em&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzEwMjc1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxMjMwZTM5Yi1mNDBhLWVlMTEtOTA3Yy0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=_RnFQS7UKCdvhdU-3mRCbiOcvoYDU9I623A9ebVxCN4=&emci=83c9f486-f00a-ee11-907c-00224832eb73&emdi=1230e39b-f40a-ee11-907c-00224832eb73&ceid=9512399) | [**DONATE NOW »** ](https://click.everyaction.com/k/64837914/411410171/1859846009?refcode=E3015-20230614-PurpleStateModel-SB-AbortionReproRights&amount=25&utm_campaign=em_230614_reprorightsalaska&utm_source=em&utm_medium=em&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzEwMjc1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxMjMwZTM5Yi1mNDBhLWVlMTEtOTA3Yy0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=_RnFQS7UKCdvhdU-3mRCbiOcvoYDU9I623A9ebVxCN4=&emci=83c9f486-f00a-ee11-907c-00224832eb73&emdi=1230e39b-f40a-ee11-907c-00224832eb73&ceid=9512399)

clean_body: Here in Alaska, abortion is still legal, and a woman’s health care choices remain her own. | | | | | | Friend, It’s been nearly a year since the U.S. Supreme Court overturned Roe v. Wade , and reproductive rights are under attack all across the country. Many Republican states are enacting laws that ban abortion in the first few weeks of pregnancy. It’s heartbreaking. Here in Alaska, abortion is still legal, and a woman’s health care choices remain her own. Alaska can be a model for other states to follow, if we can spread the word far and wide. | You might ask: How is this possible in a purple state with an anti-choice Republican governor? Our state constitution protects reproductive rights, and Alaska courts have consistently defended access to reproductive health care. It would take an amendment to Alaska’s constitution to change this, which is an unpopular idea in the legislature and among Alaskans at large. At a time when women’s rights and access to health care are being attacked, Alaska provides an example for the rest of the country. We need to make Alaskan common sense one of our main exports to the rest of the country. **One of the things I love about Callie is that there’s no challenge too daunting or too intimidating to stop her.**
When I got back from war, Callie made it her mission to fight for me — for veterans struggling to return to normal, everyday life. She’s spent more than 15 years fighting for veterans and the care they need.
When she went to U of M (with two small kids at home), she didn’t let a little peanut butter on her sweater stop her from achieving her goal. (No, seriously, have you seen how much peanut butter kids eat?)
When she decided to run for Congress, Callie didn’t allow naysayers to deter her from running. People told her going up against an incumbent politician would be too tough and, two months later, she’s proving them wrong at every turn.
**I’ve watched my wife time and time again refuse to back down from something others might say is too difficult. And that’s exactly the kind of leadership we need in Washington.**

name: Defend the Constitution
subject: Don’t let them “cancel” American history
body:
I have a special gift for you--a set of unique notecards featuring pictures of the "Liberty Walk" statues found on the Hillsdale College campus.

This sponsored message from Defend the Constitution is on behalf of Hillsdale College [ ](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=a5dbc853311f45108439a9943d9cd6d8&_e=qYdcYnTpDYK4DD4D-e94L8_qSKQu7Ke3T3J1EfuhLFyU8C6bWTmW7mWfa7A6ZxevDmrKT4BnvA94cbsj_NuYUAgXvEpCRWQRhUJYB6iHpTjQNCNbiWrpBXTayR5dAXV0iGo953W0-xgP8hlMgye3aGFu1KOn8pgmrawS_ZGHrQDFsBcQMsyU6MKKsVhZ5R2yfi7YiRa0rvgD9baHyMByyZKWzvr9RFqOX-i0iRF6mA9ztuxTlEZv-_E6TkT0Cy2ZIbIyHIdjcZuAZ3Ft5izor9x1W6dKGHk-HqTM_yGuHJ35oBvubBdY6F6piSx87cRu1gPJbm7bwdwgUZpprhNqDS4951MaEvX7qXBIqxvNP5h5NJZnRsynwxZeKimZsofyD46aXRBFyCbwjMEymFftVi3thywvmgRGVM1jdGNQBMw%3D) Friend of Liberty, I have a special gift for you--a set of unique notecards featuring pictures of the "Liberty Walk" statues found on the Hillsdale College campus. These beautiful cards include _George Washington_ and _Thomas Jefferson_ ... _Abraham Lincoln_ and _Frederick Douglass_ ... _Winston Churchill_ , _Margaret Thatcher_ , and _Ronald Reagan_. _All of these statues stand proudly on Hillsdale 's Michigan campus_--one of the only institutions of higher learning that refuses EVERY PENNY of government funding, even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants and loans. You can view the cards at this secure link: [https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/get-your-liberty-walk-notecards](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=a5dbc853311f45108439a9943d9cd6d8&_e=qYdcYnTpDYK4DD4D-e94L8_qSKQu7Ke3T3J1EfuhLFyU8C6bWTmW7mWfa7A6ZxevDmrKT4BnvA94cbsj_NuYUAgXvEpCRWQRhUJYB6iHpTjQNCNbiWrpBXTayR5dAXV0iGo953W0-xgP8hlMgye3aGFu1KOn8pgmrawS_ZGHrQDFsBcQMsyU6MKKsVhZ5R2yfi7YiRa0rvgD9baHyMByyZKWzvr9RFqOX-i0iRF6mA9ztuxTlEZv-_E6TkT0Cy2ZIbIyHIdjcZuAZ3Ft5izor-QR2ckAF_3mHDMo5Um_hozbBsC4WPkwLatm5tj-2YCKlan7txOePDG4YrvENOIn0ZFdDVrcObVsAPybjHeX8XW0VQTPkjkTJuRUgLI1h2KSn2A1iwJb6y87yylqgpoi_YZLOHEj69WAOntNFFaeIVQ%3D) Let the cards serve as a reminder to you of the vigilance and commitment needed to defend liberty--especially right now, a critical time for our country. **Sadly, several polls and events around the country show that increasing numbers of young Americans are being drawn to socialism and other ideas destructive of liberty. ** And the unrest in communities nationwide, where statues of our Founding Fathers are being vandalized or torn down, is another symptom of this underlying disease. What explains this development? As an educator and president of Hillsdale, I've been thinking about this for a long time. Here's one primary reason... For decades, the "progressive" leftist academics who became dominant in most of America's colleges and universities after the 1960s have been teaching a **biased** and **distorted** view of American history. _The New York Times '_ "1619 Project" is a prime example. According to the "1619 Project," the key to understanding America is not freedom, but slavery--and the Project's main goal is to inject this false teaching into the curricula of America's K-12 schools. Imagine young minds in classrooms all over American learning this. Does it make you as concerned as it does me? And given this trend in American education, is it any wonder that our young people feel less of a patriotic attachment to our nation and are increasingly attracted--out of ignorance--to failed ideas such as socialism, ideas that are destructive of liberty? Another sign of the "progressive" Left's influence is the continuing attempt to erase our American heritage by destroying monuments, renaming schools and streets, and censoring works of literature in the name of "political correctness." Fellow Patriot, I wanted to make sure that you didn’t miss seeing the huge victory that the AFL won for free speech this week. For well over a decade, the South Carolina establishment has been able to enforce a state statute which suppresses the speech of conservatives and any others who don’t fit their establishment mold. But thanks to the stellar legal work of the AFL Team, a U.S. District Court Judge just issued a forty-page opinion permanently blocking the enforcement of these state ethics laws that establishment politicians in South Carolina were using to limit the South Carolina Freedom Caucus’ ability to raise money, endorse candidates, and engage in other associational activities. The judge ruled that these restrictions were an impermissible ban on speech, in violation of the First Amendment and the Equal Protection Clause of the Fourteenth Amendment to the U.S. Constitution. Thanks to your support, the AFL Team was able to step up to the plate to represent the South Carolina Freedom Caucus in their challenge to this unconstitutional law, which was clearly written to favor certain groups, specifically the House Democratic Caucus, the House Republican Caucus, the Black Caucus, and the Women’s Caucus, to the detriment of the rest of state legislators who aren’t part of these favored groups. This is yet another of the many victories that the AFL Team has been able to secure to protect the foundational freedoms of all Americans. Our work and the victories that we are achieving would not be possible without your support, and for that we, and the South Carolina Freedom Caucus are truly grateful. Thank you for standing beside us as we continue to fight and win for liberty. God bless,MaryP.S. See AFL’s Press Release here: [_https://aflegal.org/major-victory-america-first-legal-prevails-in-lawsuit-to-protect-the-south-carolina-freedom-caucus-right-to-free-speech/_](http://xykkk.mjt.lu/lnk/AMYAABsWK5QAAAAN504AAEcY2LAAAAABL9MAAGV0ABg1MgBkijAXeyvmG1yLSbqWMjOx4vahcgAXqZI/2/RfnFHvFsjpieDW85OOKzOg/aHR0cHM6Ly9hZmxlZ2FsLm9yZy9tYWpvci12aWN0b3J5LWFtZXJpY2EtZmlyc3QtbGVnYWwtcHJldmFpbHMtaW4tbGF3c3VpdC10by1wcm90ZWN0LXRoZS1zb3V0aC1jYXJvbGluYS1mcmVlZG9tLWNhdWN1cy1yaWdodC10by1mcmVlLXNwZWVjaC8)

The state of California passed a law in 2022 that imposes new regulations on social media companies. This law, AB 587, requires companies to give the California Attorney General’s Office regular reports regarding disinformation, misinformation, extremism, radicalization, and hate speech. The law allows the state to impose fines if companies do not comply with these reporting regulations. You may be asking, “Isn’t controlling misinformation and hate speech online a good thing?” The truth of the matter is that the government and Big Tech companies working together to control what everyone is allowed to say is a bad thing. A good thing is when everyone is allowed to speak freely. Not everyone’s definitions of “misinformation” or “hate speech” are the same. In the case of our work at The Babylon Bee, jokes and satire are often incorrectly cited as examples of misinformation or hateful conduct by organizations and government agencies who think our views don’t fit their prescribed narrative. When people in power don’t like what you have to say, they can use that power to categorize your speech as “hateful,” even if what you’re saying is factually accurate.
---
[Stand with the Bee](http://email.alerts.therepublicanteam.com/c/eJyMkMGK8yAURp_G7FrUa7RZuPihZNd_MRRmKVdz0wiaBDUMffshwzzAbM8Hh4_z-XAPjCmur_-YybbSXKkOyXmiy0R5CwXD20ku4cL1RSgH3WSVkRPojqzQN21ugzSmW-wQgLQA0QfkcxDeB42CBw_Yz0Sz6KI9PVwLJQXwXl6NEn4Y1MRnT_xmeqY4JiqtXttChfbDpxhwbYT5GrbcJbu0tlcG_5gcmRw9-nfaVk90zkyOe8K1MhiPll2mKR6ZwZ0yxsSkPmHdjhKIwR3plwTMO8bXyuD-_HgqzkF1xU77V0wpVm2Y4q9T8HOg_anQdwAAAP__aXNtFw)
---
**_This law is not about keeping social media companies transparent — it’s about censorship._** The state of California, along with other government entities and Big Tech firms, is seeking to use censorship to protect their preferred narrative. body:
Getting ready for 2024
#
We debated whether or not to send this email.
When it comes to campaigning, our motto has always been to focus on our record, and not give any extreme right-wing opponents any free publicity.
But even if we don’t talk about them much, the reality is we have to take our Republican challengers seriously. In 2020, Alexandria was in the second most expensive House race in the country. Her challenger raised and spent more than $10 million against her. And even when our challengers don’t win, the disinformation they sow can discredit our movement if we don’t fight back.
Now, we officially have a challenger for 2024.
[We’re now asking if you will contribute $3 today to support Alexandria and ensure we have the resources to win next year? When thousands of people give what they can, it shows the power of this movement.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20230614.9cPLXM&refcode=em20230614-4477-P_FND_RES_OPP&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=4477%2E2526796%2E1SBisY)
Here are a few facts about our opponent:
* **She paid George Santos a lot of money to consult on the last election.** In 2022, she paid George Santos’ consulting firm $110,320 and hers was the only campaign to ever report working with the firm.
* **Her campaign may have been part of a scam run by George Santos.** A donor who gave to Santos had their credit card charged for additional, unauthorized donations — including two maxed-out $2,900 contributions to her campaign. 1
* She participated in the **January 6 Insurrection rally.**
* **She is associated with the white supremacist Proud Boys** and proudly posted a photo of herself with their leaders.

We know that communities in The Bronx, Queens, and across the country support our message and want AOC to stay in Congress – but we need to show it by making sure Alexandria wins again by a considerable margin.
[Can you chip in $3 or whatever you can today? Every dollar helps us reach more voters to ensure that we have the resources to reach voters all across New York’s 14th district so Alexandria wins by a HUGE margin next year.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20230614.9cPLXM&refcode=em20230614-4477-P_FND_RES_OPP&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=4477%2E2526796%2E1SBisY)
**[Contribute $3](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20230614.9cPLXM&refcode=em20230614-4477-P_FND_RES_OPP&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=21&akid=4477%2E2526796%2E1SBisY)**
Together we can keep winning and send Alexandria back to Congress for another term to keep fighting for social, economic, racial, and environmental justice for all.
Thank you for being with us,
Team AOC
1 - [talkingpointsmemo.com/muckraker/george-santos-tina-forte-flag-credit-card-charges](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/19176?t=22&akid=4477%2E2526796%2E1SBisY)

I promised to fight for the things that matter most, and I’ve kept that promise.
| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/64840398/411419470/-954707654?refcode=em_fr_2023.06.14_b2_cd_all&amount=15&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjU0MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5MTJmN2JiMC1mZDBhLWVlMTEtOTA3Yy0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=t5wLBg-Y4XIY_VUGCfVP1MOSFsF5jvNuIXB5fKD-_MM=) Hi Derek,

In a moment, I am going to share with you my thoughts on my first six months in Congress, but first I have to ask: [**Over the first 6 months of 2023 our reelection campaign has heated up, and my team is hoping to raise $5,000 this week to help power us through the second half of the year. Can you chip in just $5 before the day ends?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/64840399/411419471/-954707654?refcode=em_fr_2023.06.14_b2_cd_all&amount=5&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjU0MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5MTJmN2JiMC1mZDBhLWVlMTEtOTA3Yy0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=t5wLBg-Y4XIY_VUGCfVP1MOSFsF5jvNuIXB5fKD-_MM=)

When I wake up each morning I’m filled with gratitude and fire in my belly. Fighting for our common good alongside all of you is an honor, **and I am so proud to have brought that fight to the halls of Congress.**

We were victorious last year because our campaign resonated with western Pennsylvania families. **I promised to fight for the things that matter most** – like bringing home our supply chains, making more stuff right here, protecting workers and unions, taking on unchecked corporate power, making billionaires and big corporations pay their fair share, protecting our right to vote, ensuring that women and girls across the country have access to legal abortion – **and Derek, I’ve kept that promise.**

**But standing in the way,_every step of the way_ , has been Kevin McCarthy and the extremist GOP.** The MAGA crowd is so hellbent on protecting their billionaire backers that they’re willing to sacrifice working families, veterans, and American values.

**_And while they’re causing chaos in Congress, the GOP has found time to target our people-powered movement with misleading attack ads._**

**So here’s the plan, Derek:** It’s critical that we come together now to fight back against the right-wing extremism targeting western PA. With 17 months until Election Day, and the attacks already ramping up, it’s critical that we spend the rest of 2023 growing our grassroots team, building a rapid response arsenal, and preparing for the GOP’s attacks.

**[But doing all of that is expensive, Derek. This is a grassroots-funded campaign, so will you chip in just $5 today to help us reach our $5,000 goal and ensure our campaign has the resources we need to win next year?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/64840400/411419472/-954707654?refcode=em_fr_2023.06.14_b2_cd_all&amount=5&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjU0MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5MTJmN2JiMC1mZDBhLWVlMTEtOTA3Yy0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=t5wLBg-Y4XIY_VUGCfVP1MOSFsF5jvNuIXB5fKD-_MM=)**

Thank you so much for your support,

Chris Deluzio | | Chris Deluzio is a voting rights lawyer and Iraq war veteran representing Pennsylvania's 17th District in Congress. He's a champion for our unions, and he's fighting to guarantee good healthcare for every American, taking on corporate power, and advocating for bold action to protect and strengthen our democracy. [Please chip in to help Chris build a strong campaign that can win against the Republican machine.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/64840401/411419473/-954707654?refcode=em_fr_2023.06.14_b2_cd_all&amount=3&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjU0MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5MTJmN2JiMC1mZDBhLWVlMTEtOTA3Yy0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=t5wLBg-Y4XIY_VUGCfVP1MOSFsF5jvNuIXB5fKD-_MM=)

Peter,

We thought the government was pressuring Big Tech to censor stories about Hunter Biden’s foreign business dealings and his laptop days before the 2020 presidential election...**then brave journalists exposed the Twitter Files.**

We thought that it was likely that COVID came from a lab. Then FBI Director Christopher Wray confirmed this spring that coronavirus likely stemmed from a lab leak in Wuhan.

We thought the Steele Dossier was fake. Then we found out the **Democrats knew the dossier was false but used it to spy on President Trump’s campaign in 2016.**

**With every new bit of infomation we find that the truth is always worse than we thought.**

Last month, I was proud to join my colleagues in reintroducing Medicare for All.

Healthcare is a human right, but far too many people in our country are victims to a broken system and are unable to afford necessary care.

body:
The only reason I am here...

| Hey Peter —

I had an extra few minutes this morning, so I wanted to share some thoughts with you.

Here’s the truth:

No matter why you are reading this, I am thankful for you.

People like me don’t often make it to Congress.

I’m the son of Latino immigrants, who, with my three sisters, was raised by my single mother. I was the first in my family to attend college, cleaning the toilets of my classmates to make it work, and I joined the Marine Corps after graduating and went to Iraq.

_"Rumpled." "Disheveled." "Wrinkled."_

Each morning when I wake up, the first thing on my mind is fighting for Ohioans and the Dignity of Work – not competing for the Senate’s best dressed. That’s why sometimes, “rumpled,” “wrinkled,” and “disheveled” are the words used to describe me.

And I get it, friend. Most days, you're much more likely to find me in a Guardians sweatshirt or t-shirt than a suit and tie.

I'm running for reelection to continue fighting for the Dignity of Work – all work. Whether you punch a time clock or swipe a badge, work for tips or earn a salary, are raising children or caring for an aging parent, I'll fight for you. And fighting for all workers doesn’t require the perfect wardrobe.

Friend —
The one year anniversary of the Dobbs decision is next week. That means it's been one year since the conservative justices on the Supreme Court decided that abortion rights would no longer be protected across the country.
In the wake of that decision, various state legislatures rushed to pass restrictive abortion bans. Here in Arizona, abortions after 15 weeks were outlawed.
These bans aren't based on science. Instead, Republicans are inserting the government into intimate decisions between women and their doctors.
Our reproductive freedom shouldn't be up for debate, or subject to the whims of politicians.
We must pass legislation to protect abortion rights nationwide. I will fight for this nonstop in Congress — but every piece of grassroots support before then makes a difference.
Will you join my call to protect reproductive freedom by adding your name to this petition? This fight is more important than ever, and your voice is crucial. [https://secure.ngpvan.com/4rGM1CcI_0a27KLXAREdSQ2]

body:

Now more than ever, our movement needs the support from the grassroots. We're racing towards the end of the fundraising quarter and in just 16 days, we'll already be at the half-year mark. That means we need to be tuned in and ready to fight for our progressive values if we want to continue making change well into the future.

name: Replace Sinema
subject: Brett Kavanaugh and Kyrsten Sinema
body:
Sinema stood in the way of passing substantive voting rights legislation | | | Peter – Did you hear?**** Last week, the U.S. Supreme Court granted a major - and surprise - victory for voting rights by striking down a racially discriminatory congressional map in Alabama. Experts say the court’s decision could reverberate in other states like Georgia, Florida, Louisiana, and Mississippi – places where Republicans have drawn maps to try to suppress Black voters and other voters of color. It was a surprise decision, because conservative justices like John Roberts and Brett Kavanaugh have long sided with Republican efforts to gut the Voting Rights Act – but this time, even they knew that Republicans had gone too far. What does this have to do with Kyrsten Sinema? Well, earlier this year, she bragged on stage - in front of a room full of billionaires in Davos - that she helped stop voting rights legislation, including the _John Lewis Act_ and the _Freedom to Vote Act_ that would have addressed gerrymandering and voter disenfranchisement. In short, she was all too happy to let Republicans continue their discriminatory, racist, anti-democracy campaign against voting rights. Friend,
An ordinary person would feel pretty demoralized right after getting arraigned as an innocent man and hearing that the Department of Justice wants to send you to prison for **400 YEARS.**
But that’s why I can confidently say that my father is _extraordinary_.
_You see, after suffering that injustice, my father didn’t just get back in his car and feel terrible. And I certainly wouldn’t fault him if he had._

**Peter — Here’s the truth of it:** Once the summer months come and the weather heats up, our fundraising begins to slow down. It’s to be expected, folks are vacationing and spending money elsewhere — we totally get it. The problem is, that this year we have to support THREE different special elections, which is expensive.
